review_definition: Reviewed v1 means every investigation lane has been systematically checked. Each lane ends in source-backed claims, a bounded partial finding, or a documented open question with a next research action. It is not a claim of completeness.

status_legend.partial: Part of the relationship is proven; an important hop remains open
status_legend.reviewed_open: This lane was searched but no publishable claim was established from the reviewed source set
status_legend.verified_narrow: Verified for a specific legal entity, period or threshold only

cases.question: How far can a public-source evidence chain be proven from named farm relationships through corporate infrastructure, public money and political influence?
cases.next_best_action: Find one primary record that proves a named partner farm's exact slaughterhouse destination, or document why that record is not publicly accessible.

Scale.meaning: Company-reported market and turnover scale is documented.
Scale.gap: No comparable animal-throughput time series is yet in the public ledger.
Scale.next_action: Add comparable annual pig/cattle throughput from an authoritative source.

Farms/Suppliers.meaning: Named farm relationships and the livestock intermediary are documented.
Farms/Suppliers.gap: Exact named-farm → slaughterhouse destination remains unproven.
Farms/Suppliers.next_action: Search shipment, audit, certification, veterinary and supplier-programme records for an explicit destination.

Facilities.meaning: Several slaughter/processing locations are documented by company and authority sources.
Facilities.gap: Facility operation is proven; the named-farm shipment edge is not.
Facilities.next_action: Resolve legal operator and validity dates for every facility in the case.

Brands.meaning: The group portfolio is documented, but product-level provenance is not.
Brands.gap: Specific product/brand path from a named farm or facility is not yet proven.
Brands.next_action: Find one product or brand source that identifies the manufacturing legal entity or facility.

Retail.meaning: Broad retail exposure is described, but no named retailer relationship passes the publication threshold yet.
Retail.gap: No named retailer relationship is asserted without retailer/manufacturer evidence.
Retail.next_action: Search retailer product pages, supplier disclosures and manufacturer packaging records for a named relationship.

Public Money.meaning: Publicly funded project participation is documented.
Public Money.gap: Project participation is proven; exact recipient-level funding amount is not.
Public Money.next_action: Resolve the recipient legal entity and amount in authoritative grant records.

Procurement.meaning: The reviewed procurement source set did not establish an awarded contract to a mapped entity.
Procurement.gap: No awarded public contract to a mapped legal entity has been verified.
Procurement.next_action: Query TED, e-Vergabe and state/municipal award notices using current and historical aliases.

Lobbying.meaning: Lobbyregister activity and temporally versioned expenditure are documented.
Lobbying.gap: Lobbying records do not establish policy causation.
Lobbying.next_action: Map additional initiatives and position papers while keeping causation vocabulary constrained.

Regulatory history.gap: This is competition-law history, not an animal-welfare enforcement finding.
Regulatory history.next_action: Search authority, prosecutor and court records with explicit procedural status.

Transition.meaning: Portfolio diversification is visible, but there is no comparable animal-outcome trend yet.
Transition.gap: No animal-impact transition time series is yet published.
Transition.next_action: Build a year-by-year series for animal throughput, welfare-program coverage and alternative-protein activity.

cases.question: Can the same ZSI evidence model resolve a cooperative farm network, facilities, downstream processing and influence relationships without overclaiming?
cases.next_best_action: Prove one named farm → named Westfleisch facility relationship and resolve one downstream product or named customer edge.

Scale.meaning: Membership, workforce, site footprint, sales volume and market reach are documented from Westfleisch sources.
Scale.gap: Sales volume is not the same as live-animal throughput.
Scale.next_action: Add comparable annual slaughter/animal-throughput figures by species from authoritative or audited sources.

Farms/Suppliers.meaning: The cooperative supplier model and a regional supplier population around Coesfeld are documented.
Farms/Suppliers.gap: No individually named farm → named facility shipment is yet published in the ledger.
Farms/Suppliers.next_action: Search cooperative member profiles, audits and origin programmes for one named farm-to-facility receipt.

Facilities.meaning: Five meat centres, site functions, several legal operators and live-animal logistics are documented.
Facilities.gap: A facility list does not establish which farm supplied a particular animal.
Facilities.next_action: Resolve operator validity dates and certification identifiers for all five meat centres.

Brands.meaning: Gustoland is documented as a Westfleisch subsidiary at the Erkenschwick site with sausage/convenience production.
Brands.gap: Co-location does not prove product-level material flow from the adjacent slaughter line.
Brands.next_action: Add WestfalenLand/Gustoland legal-entity and product-manufacturing receipts.

Retail.meaning: Domestic/export market channels are documented, but no named retailer edge passes the evidence threshold.
Retail.gap: No named retailer relationship is asserted yet.
Retail.next_action: Search retailer own-brand manufacturer disclosures, packaging and supplier pages for a named edge.

Public Money.meaning: No recipient-level public-money claim was established in the source set reviewed for this v1 pass.
Public Money.gap: This is not evidence that Westfleisch entities receive no public support.
Public Money.next_action: Search EU/state aid, CAP, federal/state project and regional development records by exact legal entity.

Procurement.meaning: No awarded federal public-contract claim was established in the reviewed source set.
Procurement.gap: A missing claim is not proof that no public contracts exist.
Procurement.next_action: Query TED, e-Vergabe and state/municipal award notices using Westfleisch subsidiaries and aliases.

Lobbying.meaning: Westfleisch's VDF membership and a Westfleisch-linked VDF board role are documented alongside a VDF policy initiative.
Lobbying.gap: Association membership does not prove that Westfleisch authored or directed the VDF initiative.
Lobbying.next_action: Search for direct Westfleisch Lobbyregister entries, submissions or attributed statements before asserting company-specific lobbying positions.

Regulatory history.meaning: A historical Bundeskartellamt record documents contract slaughter for Westfleisch in a competition-law context.
Regulatory history.gap: The 2011 relationship is historical and is not an animal-welfare enforcement finding.
Regulatory history.next_action: Search current authority/court/prosecutor records and label investigation, order, fine, conviction and appeal separately.

Transition.meaning: A current higher-husbandry programme has documented participation requirements.
Transition.gap: Programme requirements do not establish system-wide participation or measured animal-outcome improvement.
Transition.next_action: Find annual programme coverage and animal-based outcome indicators to create a real transition time series.

cases.question: Can ZSI map a vertically integrated poultry system from contract farming through feed, facilities, brands, market channels and political influence?
cases.next_best_action: Resolve one named contract farmer → named PHW slaughter facility path and map the legal operators of the principal German slaughter sites.

Scale.meaning: Subsidiaries, turnover, workforce, locations and agricultural partnerships are documented.
Scale.gap: Annual animal throughput by species is not yet in the ledger.
Scale.next_action: Add comparable chicken/turkey/duck throughput from authoritative or audited sources.

Farms/Suppliers.meaning: The contract-farmer model and vertically integrated production stages are documented.
Farms/Suppliers.gap: No named contract farm → named slaughter facility path is yet proven.
Farms/Suppliers.next_action: Find a named partner-farm profile or traceability source that identifies its destination facility.

Facilities.meaning: PHW describes own hatcheries, feed mills, slaughter and processing plants within its integrated system.
Facilities.gap: The principal slaughter sites and their exact legal operators are not yet individually resolved in the ledger.
Facilities.next_action: Build the German facility table with approval numbers, legal operators and validity dates.

Brands.meaning: WIESENHOF and GREEN LEGEND relationships and origin/launch claims are documented.
Brands.gap: Brand linkage does not resolve the manufacturing legal entity for every product.
Brands.next_action: Select one WIESENHOF product and resolve its manufacturer/facility receipt.

Retail.meaning: PHW documents supply to food retail, foodservice and gastronomy, including brands and private labels.
Retail.gap: No named retailer/customer edge is asserted.
Retail.next_action: Use retailer product pages, packaging and supplier disclosures to establish one named customer relationship.

Public Money.meaning: The Lobbyregister reports no public grants above €10,000 for LOHMANN & Co. AG in the stated financial year.
Public Money.gap: This narrow negative claim cannot be generalized to the PHW group or other periods/thresholds.
Public Money.next_action: Search recipient-level public funding for other PHW legal entities and programmes.

Procurement.meaning: No awarded public-contract claim was established in the federal source set reviewed for this v1 pass.
Procurement.gap: This is not proof that PHW entities have no public contracts.
Procurement.next_action: Query TED, e-Vergabe and state/municipal award notices using PHW, WIESENHOF and subsidiary legal names.

Lobbying.meaning: A PHW-linked holding entity has a current Lobbyregister entry with expenditure and a specific animal-housing policy objective.
Lobbying.gap: Lobbying activity does not establish policy causation or adoption.
Lobbying.next_action: Map all five listed initiatives and time-version future register changes through Watchtower.

Regulatory history.meaning: No official enforcement claim met the publication threshold in this v1 source pass.
Regulatory history.gap: Media allegations or company responses are not substituted for authority/court findings.
Regulatory history.next_action: Search veterinary authorities, prosecutors and courts using exact subsidiary and facility names.

Transition.meaning: PHW's alternative-protein business field and vegan brand development are documented transition activities.
Transition.gap: These activities do not demonstrate reduced poultry throughput or improved animal outcomes.
Transition.next_action: Build a comparable time series linking animal throughput, welfare-program coverage and alternative-protein revenue/volume.
